arStrings.szText: Pulverize is {c_number}[SF_24*100|%|]{/c} larger and deals {c_number}[SF_25*100|%|]{/c} bonus damage split evenly between all targets hit.

{c_important}Pulverize{/c} is also an {c_important}Earth{/c} Skill.

{c_important}Pulverize{/c} summons powerful {c_important}{u}Tectonic Spikes{/u}{/c} from the ground that deals {c_number}{payload:UPGRADEB_DAMAGE}{/c} damage.

{c_important}Pulverize{/c} performs a powerful force punch dealing {c_number}{payload:UPGRADEC_DAMAGE}{/c} damage to all enemies in front of you. {c_important}Spirit{/c} cost increased to {c_resource}[Mod.UpgradeC ? SF_4 : (SF_4+SF_48)]{/c}.

Increase {c_important}Pulverize's{/c} damage by {c_number}[SF_39*100|x%|]{/c} and consumes up to {c_number}[SF_56]{/c} {c_important}{u}Overpower{/u}{/c} stacks to further increase the damage bonus by {c_number}[SF_40*100|x%|]{/c} and size of {c_important}Pulverize{/c} by {c_number}[SF_41*100|%|]{/c} per {c_important}{u}Overpower{/u}{/c} stack consumed.
Reduces the Spirit cost of {c_important}Pulverize{/c} by {c_number}[SF_26]{/c}.
Enemies hit with {c_important}Pulverize{/c} are {c_important}{u}Weakened{/u}{/c} for {c_number}[SF_9]{/c} seconds.

{c_important}Pulverize{/c} deals {c_number}[SF_11*100|x%|]{/c} bonus damage to the first {c_number}[SF_14]{/c} enemies hit.

This bonus is increased to {c_number}[SF_19*100|x%|]{/c} while {c_important}{u}Berserking{/u}{/c}.
